imagePrompt: A single vertical 2:3 phone flashcard illustration. Polished educational style, clear hands and object, sparse kitchen background, no writing or watermark. Show exactly the scene. Add a contrasting directional arrow for movement, no arrows for stationary actions.

cards.phrase: Hold the cup by the handle.
cards.scene: Close-up hand gripping only the handle of an upright teal mug, fingers through the handle and thumb above. Entire hand and mug visible.
A tilted mug filled with tea nearly overflowing, one hand urgently steadies it. Red warning symbol beside the liquid at the rim.
Two hands stabilize an upright mug of tea. The liquid surface is perfectly flat. No movement arrows.
Person's eyes directed at a mug on the table, dotted gaze line from the eyes to the mug. Hands away from the mug.
Person inspecting inside a clean empty mug held near the eyes, cup interior clearly visible and a small check mark.

cards.phrase: Pour some water into the cup.
cards.scene: Hand tilting a glass jug, water stream pouring into a teal mug. Downward arrow beside stream.
Spoon with white sugar directly above a mug of tea, sugar falling into tea. Downward arrow.
Hand stirring tea inside a mug with a teaspoon, circular ripple and prominent circular arrow above the mug.

cards.phrase: Bring the cup to your lips.
cards.scene: Side view hand moving mug to a person's closed lips, mug rim close to mouth, curved arrow pointing toward lips. Not drinking yet.
Person taking a small sip from a slightly tilted mug of tea, rim touching lips, tiny amount of liquid being drunk.
Steaming mug on the table, person cautiously withdrawing fingers from hot handle. Clear steam and a red heat warning symbol.
Person drinking tea from a mug held comfortably at the mouth, relaxed upright posture, cup and hand visible.
Person tilting mug steeply to drink the final drops, almost empty cup interior visible, small inset shows the empty mug.
Hands washing a teal mug with a sponge under running water over the sink. Visible soap bubbles and scrubbing motion arrow.
